body.x: With the support from Gyeongbuk Technopark Company Support Group, Autonomous a2z (CEO Ha Ji-hyeong) will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its autonomous driving cars.
Autonomous a2z is a company that challengesthe commercialization of autonomous vehicles based on the best performance andautonomous driving technology and experience in Korea.

Autonomous a2z is developing technology to mass-produce autonomous vehicles, and the VP16 SDK and MRP-2000 are applied to two-seater small electric cars, small passenger cars, large passenger cars and medium-sized buses. It will also be installed in special vehicles such as 4-seater large bus and cleaning trucks.
In addition, Autonomous a2z is developing an AI autonomous driving function that can be mounted on all mobility moving in smart cities.
The company is developing all the stepsfrom combining all data coming from the sensor to give commands that canrecognize, determine, and control (handle angle, axel, brake value, etc.) allon its own.

CEO of the company said, "We wanted to apply and introduce technology to all mobilities in the world beyond the domestic market, so we came to CES. The final goal is to mass-produce a commercialized product that is practically applicable to the smart cities being made by the government and freely accessible to the general public."

Gyeongbuk Province has formed Daegu Joint Pavilion where 44 ICT convergence ventures and SMEs and three startups will be participating. Major programs include exhibitions, investor pitching, public relations with foreign media, and post-CES review conferences. In CES 2019, Daegu and Gyeongbuk Province exchanged MOU to run joint pavilion in CES for the benefits of both parties, and the joint pavilion has been set up in CES 2020. The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global technology issues and trends at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
